data.gender_notes: Bakht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who embodies the essence of joy and happiness. Derived from the Persian word for 'rapture' or 'ecstasy'. The name Bakht carries the meaning “Joy, happiness, delight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Bakht usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual state of being fully present and enjoying the divine gifts of life.
data.etymology: Bakht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, happiness, delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bakht total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
